note: Authored blockout of the SeaWing Summer Palace. Metres relative to the island centre. Sources: Wings of Fire wiki mirror (Kingdom of the Sea page): a twelve-story pavilion of blue-tinted stone built by Prince Albatross in the Bay of a Thousand Scales, hidden under a plant canopy; the dragonets were held in its electric eel cell (The Lost Heir); a SkyWing and MudWing attack destroyed it, and the SeaWings moved to the Deep Palace. The page gives no footprint, shape, throne room or interior layout, so those are authored; the underwater Deep Palace is not modelled.
